title: Qualified baselines and continuation policy
summary: Wire UI Swing v0.2-dev13 is the current source-qualified presentation continuation. It preserves dev12 public/runtime contracts and dev10 deep Server v0.17 / Builder v0.11 / RangeRequested / workspace-context qualification, while adding renderer-owned SEMANTIC_RECORD section headings, projected status-chip treatment and explicit empty-value presentation.
invariants: Continue from packages/wire_ui_swing_v0.2-dev13 on main after merge; do not use historical feature branches as source authority.
Dev13 is API-stable over dev12: no UI_ACTION detail, RangeRequested, workspaceContext, definition/material, deauthorisation, or application-authority contract changes.
Semantic-record headings, projected status chips and empty-value placeholders are renderer presentation only and must not create semantic actions.
Retain dev10 semantic qualification for Server v0.17 flat window metadata, bounded RangeRequested, workspaceContext, real ooRexx/BSF and Builder v0.11 integration.
Presentation changes require strict Java, complete renderer regression, executable/Xvfb gates, fresh-unpack manifest verification and real-window visual inspection.
Coordinate with wire-ui-runtime before any future semantic/runtime API movement.
procedure: Start from the newest qualified packages/wire_ui_swing_v0.2-devN tree on animatedads/alchemy main.
Preserve stable semantic identities and the existing event-time UI_ACTION boundary.
Treat semantic-record hierarchy, status styling, placeholders, document metadata and navigation highlighting as renderer presentation only.
Run strict Java and the complete renderer suite; capture a real desktop for presentation changes.
If semantic/protocol code changes, coordinate with wire-ui-runtime first and rerun Server v0.17, Builder v0.11 and ooRexx/BSF integration before sealing.
Publish source through Git so autobuilder consumes the reviewed tree; do not promote stale compiled JARs as source.
